body.x: As part of the project to foster the regional fusion sports industry base supported by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and Daegu Metropolitan City (Daegu Sports Complex Industrial Support Center), SNOWMONS (president: Lee Ji-ha) will present ‘SKIATE’ at the Consumer Technology Show (CES) 2017, the world's largest IT home appliance exhibition in Las Vegas, USA.
Skiate is a hybrid product that combines skiing and skating, and anyone can easily implement skate on snow.
Skiing boards are long, so they do not move as you want, but Skiate is extremely short and lightweight, so you can get free movement.

Unlike traditional ski boards that need to be taught in a given way and shape, Skate can apply a variety of skating techniques such as roller skates, ice skates, hockey skates, and so on. Skiing and snowboarding can also be carried out, making it possible to utilize it in various ways.
Even without a lift, you can walk up and down to a certain degree of slope, and you can get down and get more exercise than regular winter leisure sports because you usually ride on flat ground.

On the other hand, Daegu Techno Park, Kyungpook National University Smart Venture Business School and Kyungpook National University Smart Drone Technology Center opened the CES Daegu Joint Pavilion and support the exhibition management and business buyer consultation of 22 companies.

CES, which is the world's largest IT exhibition, is an annual showcase that can see the flow of the global home electronics industry, is held every January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA).
